summary: Separate Research Library availability from optional settings-profile tools.
details: Library shortcuts and runtime registration use the explicit research_library target capability. Both modern targets preserve their existing Library and profile tools.

Profile export controls are omitted when profiles are unavailable, and stale export actions cannot call the codec or write a file. Target validation requires a composed Library host and data-stage entry point.

The existing browser fixture consumes actual stages, both coordinators and registered handlers. Historical targets remain disabled pending their real host adapters and native interaction/save qualification.
